json.subject: Robert, smoother ops
json.body:
Hey Robert,

Saw on LinkedIn you blend journalism with asset work at United Dev. Love that clear voice.

Guessing your 16-person crew is stuck balancing tenant calls, work orders, and new deals. Hours vanish fast.

Been building tiny AI agents that book repairs, text tenants, and sniff out new markets before rivals blink.

Could free your team in days, not months.

Got 15 min Wednesday? Want me to pencil you in?

This isn’t another clunky prop-tech… it’s lighter.
